question: The One Stop Centre Scheme for women is funded by which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nirbhaya Fund**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One-stop Centre is a centrally sponsored scheme is for women empowerment under the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
 
• It is a scheme for addressing the issue of violence against women.
 
• It aims to provide assistance and support to the women affected by violence in public and private spheres.
 
• It is funded through Nirbhaya Fund.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The one-Stop Centre scheme provides the following assistance to women-

 
• Medical assistance
 
• Legal assistance
 
• Shelter
 
• Counselling
 
• Rescue services
 
• Psycho- socio support
